description: The trainer's month in numbers, already in BRL text (no cents to convert): net and gross revenue of the last 30 days vs the 30 before (growth_pct), average ticket, recurring revenue (MRR) with active subscriptions, churn, charge success rate, what is due in the next 30 days, what is overdue (count and total) and the last 6 months of revenue, plus financial_url to open the Financial screen in the app. Use it for "how was my month?" or "how much will I receive?"; when overdue.count is above 0, call list_payments with status "overdue" to see who owes and their phone (that list also counts charges that failed). Read only: nothing is charged or sent.
name: get_financial_metrics
title: See my business numbers
